study.question: Does learned normalized event attention add material information beyond direct target-group/action counts and conditional freshness, and does its removal change the incremental value of temporal scalars?
study.hypothesis: The supplied direct target statistics may retain most validation quality when the learned event-summary branch is removed. The small freshness-versus-presence increment with attention may conceal substitution with the learned recency path; a crossed removal experiment distinguishes redundancy from complementary evidence. This is a provisional local replacement hypothesis, not a sufficiency or novelty claim. study.proposed_difference: Cross learned attention summary on/off with direct freshness/presence in a 2x2 factorial. Off cells replace the 16-wide summary with exact zeros and bypass history embedding, recency embedding and attention computation; all 32 scalar slots and evidence arithmetic are retained. All cells construct the same modules in the same order, including dormant branch parameters, so only literals differ across standalone files. This compresses the active history readout from 48 to 32 coordinates and tests conditional replacement; it does not reduce registered parameters or establish statistical sufficiency. Presence is derivable from counts. The same-round on cells reproduce the two archived target controls.
predictions: Primary planned simple effect: scalar_time AUC minus attention_time AUC. Provisional quality retention requires AUC loss <=0.0005 and Logloss increase <=0.0002. These are engineering tolerances fixed before outcomes, not significance thresholds.

Second planned simple effect: scalar_presence minus attention_presence. Analyze temporal effects scalar_time minus scalar_presence and attention_time minus attention_presence; report their difference-in-differences without claiming an independent time mechanism from a single seed.

If deterministic time substitutes for learned recency, the freshness-versus-presence AUC increment should grow when attention is absent. A similar or smaller increment weakens that substitution account.

Skipping event embedding and attention should lower measured train/inference cost or memory, but feature gathering and static embedding costs may dominate. Require host-measured train time, full inference throughput, p50/p95 batch latency and peak memory before claiming savings; >=10% throughput increase would be a practically useful result, not a guaranteed one.

On controls should match g0-r0001-target_time and g0-r0001-target_presence under the unchanged source-equivalent recipe. An unexpected mismatch triggers a source/config review before interpreting mechanism effects.

Review frozen history-length/empty-history, category-match, action-presence, time-of-day and training-frequency slices with supplied sample/positive/negative counts. In scalar models, order and unmatched identity information are discarded, but ages remain in freshness cells. Small slices are descriptive only.
falsifiers: A material AUC loss exceeding 0.0005 for scalar_time versus attention_time weakens practical replacement in this implementation; persistent paired-seed losses would refute the current local quality-retention hypothesis, not all deterministic evidence models.
If only scalar_presence loses quality while scalar_time retains it, attention removal and temporal evidence interact; an unconditional claim that age values are unnecessary is false.

If scalar_time loses quality despite adequate time evidence, semantic event representations, history-derived embedding training, or smooth learned relevance may be complementary to exact bucket matches. This result does not identify which explanation without follow-up controls.
No measured speed/memory benefit or unacceptable quality loss invalidates an efficiency claim. Equal registered parameter counts invalidate any parameter-count reduction claim.
Nonfinite logits, nonzero summary in an off cell, information-boundary violations or mismatched on-control results invalidate interpretation until resolved within budget.

Skipping learned event computation changes optimization workload; fixed epochs isolate recipe/data passes, not equal GPU time
Shared category/brand embeddings still learn through static fields; removing their history gradients is part of summary deletion
Frozen static snapshot dates are undocumented; results do not establish production point-in-time validity
Counts and presence are redundantly related; effective evidence dimension differs despite identical slot counts
Previous target_time versus target_presence has higher AUC but worse Logloss; checkpoint/metric tradeoffs are not a robust independent temporal gain
Deterministic exact matches use host buckets and may include collisions; all claims are scoped to this frozen representation
